pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped dark regions with jagged, high-frequency edge gradients. Patches on the upper flank are larger and more complex than those on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of light-colored pathways with primarily tri-radial junction nodes. Pathway width is narrowest on the dorsal-lateral region and increases slightly toward the ventral area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, upright dark fringe with a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the background along the upper neck.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A localized thinning and height reduction in the mane profile is visible at the posterior neck/shoulder transition.
